description: Render a gradient background image (website hero, OG image, launch post, slide, wallpaper) with Gradients Studio's renderer: blobs, stripes or clouds, real grain, pixel and dither finishes, shape overlays. Workflow: start from suggest_settings or list_palettes, call this WITHOUT `size` for a free 960px preview (returned inline, no API key needed), adjust the `settings` you get back, and pass `size` (exact pixels, e.g. [1200, 630] for an OG image, [2560, 1440] for a hero) once the person is happy. A sized export needs an API key; it uses one of the account's monthly exports (5 free, unlimited on Pro) and returns a URL that is valid for 24 hours; asking for the same export again within that time returns the same URL for free. Every result includes `settings` (send them back to iterate) and `studioUrl` (open it to take over in the browser). Use `overlaySvg` with the raw text of a logo SVG to draw it as concentric outlines over the gradient. For the soft mesh look keep blur at 700–900 and contrast at 130; saturated mid-tone colors render best, muddy ones come out dull.

aspectRatio.description: Frame shape for a preview, e.g. '16:9' hero, '1.91:1' OG image, '4:5' LinkedIn post, '9:16' story. Ignored when size is given.

backgroundColor.description: Base color as #RRGGBB. Dark values give the premium look; light ones give pastels.

blur.description: Softness of the color fields in export pixels, 0–1000. Keep 700–900 for the soft mesh look; below 500 the blobs show hard edges.

colors.description: 1–8 gradient colors as #RRGGBB. Three or four is typical. Use saturated mid-tones; muddy or near-grey colors come out dull.

contrast.description: Contrast 50–200 (%). 100 is flat; 130 is the studio default and what makes colors read. Don't lower it for 'subtle', lower grain instead.

coverage.description: Clouds only: how much of the frame the clouds fill, 0–2.

ditherChars.description: Dither only: characters to draw instead of the built-in symbols, e.g. '01' or '+-'. Up to 16.

ditherGlyphsOnly.description: Dither only: true draws only the characters over the smooth gradient (no cell quantizing).

effect.description: Finish over the gradient: 'none', 'pixel' (dot matrix) or 'dither' (palette-quantized cells and glyphs). Pixel and dither preview free and export on Pro.

effectOpacity.description: 0–1 blend of the finish over the smooth gradient; 1 replaces it, 0.5 shows both.

effectSize.description: Finish cell size in export pixels, 8–64. 24 default; 40+ reads as deliberate at feed size.

effectStrength.description: Finish density 0–2 (dot size for pixel, glyph density for dither).

fiberDensity.description: Stripes only: how many fibers, 0–2 (1 = designed look).

format.description: Export file format. JPEG is ~8x smaller; grain makes PNGs large.

grain.description: Film-grain strength 0–0.8. 0.2 is subtle, 0.3+ is visibly textured. Grain also hides banding.

overlay.description: 'none' or 'shapes' for concentric outlines of one shape radiating from a point.

overlayCenter.description: Ring origin as [x, y] fractions of the frame, e.g. [0.88, 0.18] for top-right; omit for a seeded point.

overlayClip.description: Clip instead of rings: the whole gradient is drawn inside the overlay shape, on overlayClipBackground

overlayClipBackground.description: Hex color around a clipped shape (off-white by default)

overlayOpacity.description: Overlay outline opacity 0–1. 0.15–0.4 stays a texture; higher becomes a graphic.

overlayPath.description: Set by the server from overlaySvg; do not pass directly.

overlayShape.description: Overlay shape: circle, square, rounded, squircle, diamond, triangle, hexagon, star, flower, seal, heart, or 'custom' with overlaySvg.

overlaySize.description: Base shape size in export pixels, 100–3000.

overlaySpacing.description: Gap between rings in export pixels, 10–200.

overlayStroke.description: Ring stroke width in export pixels, 1–20.

overlaySvg.description: Raw text of an SVG (a logo) to draw as concentric outlines; sets overlay to shapes/custom. Up to 64 KB.

placement.description: Where color points sit: 'center' for a calm middle, 'random' for an off-center composition.

saturation.description: Saturation 50–200 (%). 100 is neutral; 110–120 keeps the palette alive against grain and dither, which both mute it.

seed.description: Composition seed (integer). Reuse it to keep the layout while changing colors or finish; omit for a random one.

sheen.description: Stripes only: highlight along the fibers, 0–2. 0.2 is the default.

size.description: Exact export size in pixels [width, height], each 64–3840, e.g. [1200, 630]. Omit for a free 960px preview (no key needed); giving a size needs an API key and uses one monthly export.

style.description: 'blobs' (soft overlapping fields), 'stripes' (flowing silk fibers), 'clouds' (billowing volumes) or 'rays' (soft god rays fanning from above).

waviness.description: Stripes only: how much the fibers bend, 0–2.

name: render_gradient

exportUrl.description: Download URL of the sized export, valid 24 hours

resetsOn.description: Date the free pool refills, YYYY-MM-DD

settings.description: The resolved settings; send them back to iterate

studioUrl.description: Opens the studio with these settings, for a person to take over

title: Render a gradient background
